verdict.rationale: Anrok's Transactions API syncs transactions from a seller's billing system, and the createOrUpdate endpoint saves each transaction and associates it with the right tax return. The docs also reference a Stripe integration and Shopify support. However, nothing shows historical backfill imports, a broad connector catalog, or consolidation of multiple channels into a single filing. missing for 10: documented historical/bulk backfill import, an enumerated set of processor and storefront connectors, evidence that multi-channel transactions are merged into the same filings, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, transactions from every channel can be imported — API backfills and connector syncs from other processors and storefronts — so filings cover my whole business, not just one integration

citations.quote: Use Anrok's Transactions API to synchronize transactions between Anrok and your billing system, as well as calculate sales tax for new invoices.
this endpoint also saves the transaction in Anrok and associates it with the appropriate tax return
while continuing to use Anrok's Stripe integration to manage tax for subsequent billing cycles.
Anrok recalculates and verifies Shopify's calculations to ensure accuracy.
